title: Cow holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <!-- Body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='62' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='75' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3a3a5c'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='80' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e8e0d0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='82' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e8e0d0'/>
  <rect x='58' y='82' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e8e0d0'/>
  <rect x='66' y='80' width='6' height='12' rx='2' fill='#e8e0d0'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='89' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='89' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='89' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
  <rect x='66' y='89' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='52' rx='15' ry='14' fill='#f5f0e8'/>
  <!-- Ear left -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='42' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#e8d0c0' transform='rotate(-20 56 42)'/>
  <!-- Ear right -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='42' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#e8d0c0' transform='rotate(20 80 42)'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='58' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#f0c8c0'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='71' cy='57' r='1.5' fill='#c08080'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='57' r='1.5' fill='#c08080'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='48' r='3' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='47' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Horns -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='38' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#e8d8a0'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='38' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#e8d8a0'/>
  <!-- Arms holding heart -->
  <path d='M42 62 Q35 55 36 48' stroke='#e8e0d0' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 62 Q62 55 60 48' stroke='#e8e0d0' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Heart -->
  <path d='M48 38 C48 33 42 30 39 34 C36 30 30 33 30 38 C30 44 39 49 39 49 C39 49 48 44 48 38 Z' fill='#ff4d6d' transform='translate(0 5)'/>
  <!-- Heart shine -->
  <path d='M36 36 Q34 34 36 33' stroke='#ffb3c0' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M22 68 Q14 64 16 56' stroke='#e8e0d0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='55' r='3' fill='#5a4a3a'/>
</svg>
